instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\impeller_test.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv in SolidCAM. Use SolidCAM Simultaneous 5X to create a multi-axis finishing toolpath for C:\Users\User\Desktop\impeller_test.step. The simplified impeller has six blades; use A-axis rotary output for the multi-axis motion, and make the tool axis follow the blade channels while avoiding holder collision. Tool definition: use the supplied simultaneous 5-axis finishing tool and holder settings. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-19.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
